# Brand setup, identity and brand formats

`brand.setup` derives the whole token set of a brand (palettes, roles, type, space, radii) from a few inputs, as the admin's Brand setup screen does. The other `brand.*` operations manage the brand identity, format presets and templates, and render brand images.

[`brand.setup`](#brandsetup) · [`brand.presets`](#brandpresets) · [`brand.templates`](#brandtemplates) · [`brand.updateIdentity`](#brandupdateidentity) · [`brand.createPreset`](#brandcreatepreset) · [`brand.renamePreset`](#brandrenamepreset) · [`brand.deletePreset`](#branddeletepreset) · [`brand.createTemplate`](#brandcreatetemplate) · [`brand.updateTemplate`](#brandupdatetemplate) · [`brand.deleteTemplate`](#branddeletetemplate) · [`brand.rebuildTemplate`](#brandrebuildtemplate) · [`brand.render`](#brandrender) · [`brand.save`](#brandsave)

## brand.setup

Set the site's brand from three colours, a type pairing, a type ratio and base size, a spacing unit and a corner style: the server derives every token write of the brand (the brand, accent and neutral palette ramps, the light and dark colour roles as aliases of palette steps, the font sizes and families, the main type presets, the space steps and the radii) and lands them as one designSystem.setTokens change, gated once for AA contrast on the end state, so one undo restores the lot. A brand with pairs below AA is refused unless the input carries `acknowledgeContrast: true`, the designer's explicit "save anyway", which the stored batch keeps; then the failing pairs come back as error findings. The admin's Brand setup screen runs this same operation.

- permission `designSystem.operation` (admin, workspace owner, editor (as the access settings allow)); class `transaction`; writes `designSystem`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `primary` | string | yes |
| `secondary` | string | yes |
| `neutral` | string | yes |
| `headingFamily` | string (min 1)[] | yes |
| `bodyFamily` | string (min 1)[] | yes |
| `typeRatio` | 1.125 \| 1.2 \| 1.25 \| 1.333 | yes |
| `baseSize` | integer ≥14 ≤22 | yes |
| `spaceBase` | 4 \| 8 | yes |
| `radius` | "sharp" \| "soft" \| "round" \| "pill" | yes |
| `acknowledgeContrast` | true |  |

Output: { tree?: { pageId: string, revision: integer ≥-9007199254740991, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { kind: "root", … } \| { kind: "section", … } \| { kind: "repeater", … } \| { kind: "outlet", … } \| { kind: "primitive", … } \| { kind: "component", … } \| { kind: "instance", … (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"primary":"#1e3d4f","secondary":"#c8553d","neutral":"#737373","headingFamily":["DM Sans","sans-serif"],"bodyFamily":["DM Sans","sans-serif"],"typeRatio":1.25,"baseSize":17,"spaceBase":4,"radius":"soft"}
```

> `acknowledgeContrast: true` saves a brand whose pairs fail AA. Set it only when the user explicitly says to save anyway.

## brand.presets

List the site's brand presets, the brand identities its brand templates draw from, each with its id, name and last change. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { presets: { presetId: string, presetName: string, updatedAt: string }[] }

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## brand.templates

List the site's brand templates, the fixed-size canvases (a social post, a banner) brand.render draws: each with its name, size, status (draft or approved), version and canvas page. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { templates: ({ id: string (min 1), name: string, pageId: string (min 1), snapshot: { canvas: { width: …, height: … }, frame: string (min 1), frameOverrides: … \| …, tree: { format: …, v: …, revision: …, root: … } } \| null, customerSettings: Record<string, …[] (≤128)> \| null, status: "draft" \| "approved", version: numbe… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## brand.updateIdentity

Patch a brand identity (the default preset's, or `presetId`'s): its brand name, tagline, logos, the four brand colours, the headline and body roles, the tone words, the concept (the creative idea every design repeats) and the do and don't rules: the brand brief agents read at libretto://site/<id>/brand. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `presetId` | string (min 1) |  |
| `identity` | { brandName?: string, tagline?: string, logoPrimary?: string \| null, logoInverse?: string \| null, logoMark?: string \| null, brandPrimary?: string, brandSecondary?: string, brandSurface?: string, brandOnSurface?: string, headlineRole?: string, bodyRole?: string, toneWords?: string, concept?: string, doRules?: string, do… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |

Output: { identity: { brandName: string, tagline: string, logoPrimary: string \| null, logoInverse: string \| null, logoMark: string \| null, brandPrimary: string, brandSecondary: string, brandSurface: string, brandOnSurface: string, headlineRole: string, bodyRole: string, toneWords: string, concept: string, doRules: string, dont… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"identity":{"brandName":"Studio","tagline":"Architecture and landscape"}}
```

## brand.createPreset

Add a brand preset named `presetName`: a copy of preset `cloneFrom`, or without it the theme's default identity for the site. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `presetName` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `cloneFrom` | string (min 1) |  |

Output: { presetId: string, presetName: string, updatedAt: string }

Example input:

```json
{"presetName":"Autumn campaign"}
```

## brand.renamePreset

Rename a brand preset. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `presetId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `presetName` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |

Output: { presetId: string, presetName: string, updatedAt: string }

Example input:

```json
{"presetId":"autumn-campaign","presetName":"Autumn campaign 2026"}
```

## brand.deletePreset

Delete a brand preset; the site's last one is refused (409 brand_last_preset). Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `presetId` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { status: "deleted" }

Example input:

```json
{"presetId":"autumn-campaign"}
```

## brand.createTemplate

Create a brand template: a canvas page of `width` by `height` pixels (fixed at creation) with a first section, laid out from one of the theme's canvas presets when `layoutId` names one. Edit its content with tree.commit on its page, then approve it with brand.updateTemplate. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`, `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string (min 1, max 120) | yes |
| `width` | integer ≥16 ≤4096 | yes |
| `height` | integer ≥16 ≤4096 | yes |
| `layoutId` | string (min 1) |  |

Output: { id: string (min 1), name: string, pageId: string (min 1), snapshot: { canvas: { width: integer ≥16 ≤4096, height: integer ≥16 ≤4096 }, frame: string (min 1), frameOverrides: Record<string, any> \| null, tree: { format: "splash.tree", v: 3, revision: integer ≥0, root: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, vis… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"name":"Instagram post","width":1080,"height":1080}
```

## brand.updateTemplate

Rename a brand template, approve it (`status: "approved"` with `expectedDraftRevision`, the canvas revision you approve: that canvas becomes the version brand.render draws) or set which of its fields a person may change when generating (`customerSettings`). Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`, `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `patch` | object | yes |
| `patch.name` | string (max 120) |  |
| `patch.status` | "draft" \| "approved" |  |
| `patch.customerSettings` | Record<string, string (min 1)[] (≤128)> \| null |  |
| `patch.expectedDraftRevision` | string |  |

Output: { id: string (min 1), name: string, pageId: string (min 1), snapshot: { canvas: { width: integer ≥16 ≤4096, height: integer ≥16 ≤4096 }, frame: string (min 1), frameOverrides: Record<string, any> \| null, tree: { format: "splash.tree", v: 3, revision: integer ≥0, root: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, vis… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b","patch":{"name":"Instagram post, square"}}
```

## brand.deleteTemplate

Delete a brand template, then its canvas page. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`, `pages`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"}
```

## brand.rebuildTemplate

Recreate the canvas page of a brand template whose page was deleted, from its last approved snapshot (refused when it has none); edits made after that approval do not come back. Brand validation applies, and history.undo restores the brand rows the batch changed.

- permission `site.admin` (admin); class `transaction`; writes `brand`, `pages`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |

Output: { id: string (min 1), name: string, pageId: string (min 1), snapshot: { canvas: { width: integer ≥16 ≤4096, height: integer ≥16 ≤4096 }, frame: string (min 1), frameOverrides: Record<string, any> \| null, tree: { format: "splash.tree", v: 3, revision: integer ≥0, root: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, vis… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b"}
```

## brand.render

Render an approved brand template to a PNG (`scale` 1 or 2) in a brand preset (`presetId`), with the overrides of the fields its curation lets a person change (`overrides`, by node), and answer it as base64 without storing it. The render runs in a standalone boundary; run it alone in a batch.

- permission `brand.generate` (admin); class `external`; writes nothing; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `presetId` | string (min 1) |  |
| `scale` | 1 \| 2 |  |
| `overrides` | any |  |

Output: { png: string, contentType: "image/png", filename: string, templateVersion: integer, width: integer, height: integer, warnings: string[] }

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b","scale":1}
```

## brand.save

Render an approved brand template as brand.render does and store the PNG in the media library, with the record of how it was made. The render runs in a standalone boundary; run it alone in a batch.

- permission `brand.generate` (admin); class `external`; writes `media`, `generations`; undoable with `history.undo`; external: alone in its batch, never in a dry run.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `templateId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `presetId` | string (min 1) |  |
| `scale` | 1 \| 2 |  |
| `overrides` | any |  |

Output: { kind: "template", media: { id: uuid, kind: "image" \| "svg" \| "video" \| "document", filename: string (min 1, max 255), mime: string (min 1, max 127), size: integer ≥0, url: string (min 1, max 2048), width?: integer ≥1 ≤100000, height?: integer ≥1 ≤100000, variants: ({ width: integer ≥1 ≤100000, height?: integer ≥1 ≤10… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"templateId":"4e5f6a7b-8c9d-4e0f-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b","scale":2}
```
